questions.question: Which of the following is a famous Tamil epic composed by Ilango in ancient India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Silappadikaram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A famous** Tamil epic, the silappadikaram, was composed by a poet named Ilango, around 1800 years ago.**
 
• It is a** story of a merchant named Kovalan, who lived in Puhar and fell in love with a courtesan named Madhavi, neglecting his wife Kannagi.**
 
• Later, he and Kannagi left Puhar and went to Madhurai, where he was wrongly accused of theft by the court jeweler of the Pandya king.
 
• The king sentenced kovalan to death.
 
• Kannagi, who still loved him, was full of grief and anger at this injustice and destroyed the entire city of Madhurai.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shishupala Vadha:**

 
 
• It is a work of classical Sanskrit poetry composed by Magha in the 7th or 8th century.
 
• It is an epic poem in 20 sargas of about 1800 highly ornate stanzas, and is considered one of the five Sanskrit mahakavyas, or "great epics".
 
 
 
• **Aitareya Brahamana:**
 
 
• It is the Brahamana of the Shakala Shakha of the Rigveda, an ancient Indian collection of sacred hymns.
 
• This work, according to tradition, is ascribed to Mahidasa Aitareya.
 
 
 
• **Ramacharitam:**
 
 
• It is a Sanskrit epic poem written in Arya meter by Sandhyakar Nandi during Pala Empire.
 
• This work simultaneously narrates the story of the Ramayana and the Pala King Ramapala.

questions.question: The average of 9 numbers is 51. Average of three of them is 49 and average of four of the remaimng numbers is 46. What is the average of the remaining numbers?

**Given:**

The average of 9 numbers is 51.

The average of three of them is 49.

And the average of 4 of the remaining numbers is 46.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 9 numbers average = 51

Now, out of 9, 3 numbers average = 49

It means, 51 - 49 = 2 (Remained from the total average)

Now, average for next 4 numbers = 46

It means, 51 - 46 = 5 (Remained from the total average)

Therefore, Average of remaining 2 numbers,

⇒ (2 × 3) + (5 × 4) + (2 × 51)/2

⇒ 6 + 20 + 102/2 

⇒ 128/2 = 64

∴ The average of the remaining numbers is 64.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of the observations) / (Number of observations)

**Calculation:**

The average of 9 numbers is 51.

Sum of 9 numbers = 9 × 51 = 459

The average of three of them is 49.

Sum of 3 numbers = 3 × 49 = 147

And the average of 4 of the remaining numbers is 46.

Sum of 4 numbers = 4 × 46 = 184

The sum of the remaining numbers = 459 – (147 + 184) = 128

The average of the remaining numbers = 128over(9-7) = 128over2 = 64

**∴ The average of the remaining numbers is 64.**
